items.question: How does the fruition of this practice lead to the assimilation of each principle within one's own mind?
premises: The practice described has a specific fruition.
This fruition operates within the practitioner's mind.
Each respective principle becomes assimilated into one's own self.
items.inference: Through the fruition of this practice, every corresponding principle is realized in the mind as identical with one's own self.
uncertainties: The exact referent of asyāḥ depends on the preceding ritual or contemplative context.
items.plain_english: Through the fruition of this, each respective principle becomes made one with one's own self in the mind.
